source_recovery.method: regenerate each corpus sweep, VERIFY by kernel_hash (unified kernel_hash_for); 0 matched by name/position

corrected.context: feature vector corrected (launch + size + covers + r/w)

features_added_vs_original_27.problem_size: vector[0]: the size the launch covers; without it same-kernel different-n launches collide
features_added_vs_original_27.covers: min(threads, n): the work actually performed; also the scale for all per-thread estimates (guarded-out threads do no memory/compute)
features_added_vs_original_27.estimated_add/mul/div_ops: operator split of the flop count: add/mul/div run on different units (div 137% slower at the same launch), one flop number cannot see that
features_added_vs_original_27.num_call_sites: opaque work the op counters cannot see (fmaxf in relu, atomicAdd in stage-5, __syncthreads)
features_added_vs_original_27.note: positions 0..27 unchanged; the five new fields append at 28..32. normalize rewritten by NAME after the old positional code indexed grid_x at a problem_size slot.
